body:
Insists on the crew’s terms and accompanies the attempt to recover the captain.

Recorded role and choices

During the July 2025 exchange, Jacks challenges the company’s handling of the captain, insists Edgar accompany the group and objects to changing the agreed terms. The scene supports a named crew member with a distinct part in the standoff. Her image is attached to that identity rather than used to identify every unnamed female pirate in the archive.

Prominence and evidence

Prominence unrated. The source footprint alone does not establish the importance of this identity. Consequences, institutional or witness role and relationships need a supported assessment.

Recorded presence combines dialogue volume and span. A brief appearance can still have lasting consequences; missing context is left unrated rather than assigned a low importance.
